0022600009.text: Houston is 1-0 after a win and sits 1st in the Southwest and the West, and this is the Rockets' second game of the season. San Antonio is 0-1 after a loss, sitting 4th in the Southwest and 13th in the West. Steven Adams is out for Houston with calf soreness, while Jayden Quaintance is out for San Antonio after knee surgery and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision. The Rockets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 145-120 defeat in San Antonio on March 8, 2026, and the teams have not met yet this season.
